situation: An elderly clockmaker at his workbench uses fine tweezers to reset a tiny brass gear inside an open grandfather clock.

brief: An old watchmaker leans over a wooden workbench under a heavy brass desk lamp, holding tiny tweezers to reattach a delicate gear inside the exposed movement of a brass clock. The damaged spring lies on the green felt mat beside him, while the freshly fitted gear gleams with clean metal under the focused light.
